```python
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
from pyscf import gto, dft
s='OCC1(CO)NC1C#C'
m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(s))
params=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); params.randomSeed=17
status=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,params)
print('RDKit embedding status:',status)
if status != 0: raise RuntimeError('Conformer embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
conf=m.GetConformer()
atom_lines=[]
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 p=conf.GetAtomPosition(a.GetIdx())
 atom_lines.append(f'{a.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.9f} {p.y:.9f} {p.z:.9f}')
mol=gto.M(atom='\n'.join(atom_lines),basis='6-31G*',charge=0,spin=0,unit='Angstrom',verbose=0)
calc=dft.RKS(mol); calc.xc='B3LYP'; calc.conv_tol=1e-9; calc.max_cycle=150
energy=calc.kernel()
if not calc.converged: raise RuntimeError('B3LYP SCF did not converge')
occ=np.where(calc.mo_occ>0)[0]
virt=np.where(calc.mo_occ==0)[0]
homo=float(calc.mo_energy[occ[-1]])
lumo=float(calc.mo_energy[virt[0]])
print('Structure SMILES:',Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('Formula:',Chem.rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
print('Method: B3LYP/6-31G* single-point; RDKit ETKDGv3 conformer, MMFF optimized')
print('SCF total energy (Ha):',energy)
print('HOMO (Ha):',homo)
print('LUMO (Ha):',lumo)
print('HOMO-LUMO gap (Ha):',lumo-homo)
```
